person.occupation: Author, Animal Rights Activist, Religious Publisher

note.p: Macaulay appears once in the diaries 25.12.1835('adv.'),and is labelled as 'Sceptic'. This indicates that he was James Macaulay, staunch critic and sceptic of the consumption of meat. Following this, his first essay titled 'Essay on Cruelty to Animals' was published in 1939, and he would go on to disperse writings on this topic between other publiations regarding European Geography and religion, the latter being aimed at children. He joined the 'Literary Gazette' in 1850, and toured both America and Ireland in the 1870s, publishing editorials on each; again, aimed at a younger audience. This identification is tentative.
